author: TeIq
content:
## Background

Today `polaris-frontend/src/components/third_party_labels_panel.rs` renders every label as a stacked card. With labels from 5+ labelers and 20+ labels total, the panel takes more page real-estate than the case content itself. Operator feedback (verbatim): "display *all* of them in an easy to navigate system instead of just taking up more page space."

## Task

Restructure the panel as a two-level grouped view:

```
Third-party labels (24)                              [filter ___________]
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
▼ Alt Text Labeler (17)             @alt-text.bsky.social
   • [APPLIED]  alt-text-missing    on at://.../app.bsky.feed.post/3l...
                                    applied 2026-04-22 14:33 UTC
   • [APPLIED]  alt-text-missing    on at://.../app.bsky.feed.post/3l...
   ...
▶ XBlock Screenshot Labeller (2)    @xblock.bsky.social
▶ US Politics Labeler (1)           @uspol.bsky.social
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```

- Each labeler is a section header (`<details>` element, native disclosure widget — no JS required).
- Header shows: display name (fallback handle, fallback truncated DID) + count badge.
- Expanded section shows label rows in the existing stacked form.
- Filter input filters by label `val` (substring match, case-insensitive) — rows hidden via CSS `[hidden]` attribute, not DOM removal, so collapse/expand state is preserved.
- Default state: collapsed when total labels > 10; otherwise expanded.

## Frontend / Leptos quality

- Use `<details>` + `<summary>` for collapse/expand — native, accessible, no `wasm-bindgen` event plumbing.
- Filter state in a `RwSignal<String>`; derived `Signal<Vec<NetworkContextLabel>>` filters in pure Rust.
- BEM class names per existing convention: `third-party-labels-panel__group`, `__group-header`, `__group-summary`, `__group-list`, `__filter`.
- All CSS in `polaris-frontend/styles/components/third-party-labels-panel.css` — tokens only (no literal colours), per `polaris-frontend/tests/styles_tokens.rs`.
- WCAG: `<summary>` is keyboard-focusable by default; ensure focus ring uses `--color-border-focus`.

## Acceptance

1. Panel renders all labels grouped by labeler with collapsible sections.
2. Filter input narrows visible labels live, with collapse/expand state preserved.
3. `cargo test -p polaris-frontend --test styles_tokens` passes (no literal colour values).
4. `trunk build --release` succeeds; visual smoke against operator's account shows compact navigable layout.
